correctness.rationale: Verified affine reduction and one-dimensional overlap pushforward: each coordinate gives a plateau atom at one and constant ramp density. Multiplying these distributions yields V=d1*d2+2(1-theta)(m1*d2+m2*d1)+4(1-theta+theta log theta)m1*m2. The crossed-ratio derivative is strictly negative until nesting; on 1<=r<=rho, V=rho+1+4theta log theta+(1-2theta)(r+rho/r), giving precise minimizer families at both sides and at theta=1/2. Differentiation yields -2A(sqrt(rho)-1)^2. Independently checked exact deficit identities symbolically; finite numerical script read but did not substitute for proof.
